levels.surface: يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
داود بن عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: «قالا حدثنا المقرئ» : the two co-transmitters are one level; the route runs through them to Dawud and his father
Khabbab, Ibn Umar and Aisha are in the scene; Abu Hurayra, quoted as hearing the Prophet, is the last link (rule 6)
«فذكر معنى حديث سفيان» refers to another report: left out
